title: Twitter: Trends, Search, and Hashtags
description: Add trending topics, full-text search, and hashtag extraction.

data.text: Add trending topics by counting hashtags in a time window, full-text search across tweets, and hashtag-based discovery.

data.title: TrendingService and SearchIndex
Trending window matters
data.text: Trending topics should decay over time. Use a sliding window (last 1 hour or 24 hours) and reset counts periodically. Otherwise old viral tweets dominate forever.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: TrendingService counts hashtags in a time window
Inverted index enables O(1) word lookup
Search combines results from multiple query words
data.takeaway: Twitter trends are a time-series counting problem. Search is an inverted index problem. Both are solved with simple data structures.
